title: robotindex Directory
description: The full browse structure of the robotindex Directory — every product organized by category and subcategory, in display order. This is the catalog shape; the actual per-product data (specs, pricing, editorial, sourcing) lives one file per product under data/products/<productId>.json, keyed by the productId referenced here. Regenerated from directory.html — the site's own authoritative source for category/subcategory/tier assignment.

$schema.description: Editor/tooling hint pointing back at this schema file. Not semantically meaningful.

name.description: e.g. 'Four Legs'. Empty string when the category has no subcategory split (e.g. Robot Arms).
Display name, as shown in the directory listing.

productId.description: References the matching record's 'id' field in data/products/<productId>.json — NOT the .html slug. Every productId here must have a corresponding product record.

openSource.description: Present and true only when this product qualifies under robotindex's Strict Open Source policy.

pending.description: Present and true only for a not-yet-released or availability-unconfirmed product. Distinct from tier.
